- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with direct links for easier onboarding from ClawHub.

apidot-wan-2-5-api 1.0.0 initial release

- Provides a documentation-only skill for APIDot Wan 2.5 API workflows, including text-to-video and image-to-video use cases.
- Guides users to official APIDot docs and model-specific pages for request planning and async integration patterns.
- Emphasizes safe handling of API keys and security best practices.
- Includes local summary notes for routing, workflow, and integration guidance—no executable code or network access.
- Directs users to reference links and usage recommendations for Wan 2.5 and related APIDot models.
